title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's parents arrive in Belfast ahead of potential India debut
summary: Teenage sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, the youngest ever selected for India's men's team, is poised for a potential international debut against Ireland. His rapid rise, marked by a record-breaking List A fifty and a stellar IPL 2026 season, has generated immense excitement.
